Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1099
Claimant:
Sarah Foster
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
05/08/2023
First notice of loss received for a rear-end collision on a city arterial road. The claimant reports being stopped at a
signal when their vehicle was struck from behind, and a claim file has been opened for both vehicle damage and
bodily injury.
05/26/2023
Confirmed the driver is named on the policy and that coverage was in force at the time of the loss. Nothing in the
policy records or the account suggests the damage predates the coverage period.
06/01/2023
Contacted the claimant to take a recorded statement. They describe the impact as sudden and forceful and say they
felt a sharp pain in the shoulder almost immediately afterward.
07/01/2023
Police report obtained. The responding officer documented the calimant in the driver's seat at the scene and recorded
the rear-end impact, consistent with what the claimant described.
07/06/2023
Obtained statements from two independent witnesses, both of whom saw the collision and confirm the sequence of
events as the claimant gave it. Photographs from the scene were also received and show the vehicles in the positions
described.
07/19/2023
The other driver's statement matches the claimant's account of how the collision occurred. No dispute has been
raised about fault for the impact.
07/20/2023
Inspected the claimant's vehicle. The rear damage is consistent with the force and direction of the impact described,
and no prior damage to the same areas appears in our records or in the inspection.
08/30/2023
Claimant's medical records show a shoulder injury consistent with the type and force of the collision. The claimant
reports no earlier injury to that body area, and none appears in the available history.
11/11/2023
Follow-up call with the claimant. They added a few minor details about the moments after the impact, but the core
account remains unchnaged from the first statement.
11/15/2023
Treatment has continued somewhat longer than is typical for this kind of shoulder injury. The treating provider's notes
explain the progress and the claim is being monitored for reasonableness of ongoing care.
11/30/2023
Claim remains open pending final medical updates. Vehicle repair authorization and the inujry evaluation are both
being processed, with no coverage concerns identified at this stage.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
